definition: זוּזִים proper name, of a people an ancient trans-Jordanic people , dwelling in הָם Gen 14:5 otherwise unknown; abode apparently in (later) land of Ammon, between Bashan and Moab; commonly supposed = זַמְזֻמִּים q. v., in that case perhaps text error in one case or the other, compare Nö Untersuchungen z. Kritik d. A. T. 162. — ( ᵐ5 ἔθνη ἰσχυρά ). — On proper name, of a location Ζιζα , , between Bosra and Lejûn, compare Kn Di on the passage, Tristr Moab 182 ff .
